title: Measure whether a knowledge brief saves an agent work
goal: kb/_self/reports/backlog-briefs.md records one comparison, with its setup: the same backlog task, carrying a knowledge field, worked by a fresh subagent with a compact brief (the packs of its asks and its referenced facts with path:line and tags, no prose) and without it, each run's turns, tool calls, tokens and requests read with backlog.py cost ID --runs, and whether its checks passed first time, at least three runs per arm. The report ends with one line 'Verdict: build' when the with-brief arm used fewer tokens and had no more refused dones than the arm without it in every run, else 'Verdict: drop'.
